tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i bstod pa rgyud gsum la 'jug pa rin po che'i phreng ba dri ma med pa zhes bya ba'i don 'grel khog phub 'phrin las mkha' khyab ces bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ya/ dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i rigs bdag rdo rje 'chang / /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas/ /bdag med bstod pa rin chen phreng ba yi/ /don 'grel khog phug 'phrin las mkha' khyab spel/ /zhes mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bcas nas rgyud gsum la 'jug pa rin po che'i phreng ba dri ma med pa zhes bya ba 'di 'chad pa la gsum ste/ klad kyi don dang / gzhung gi don dang / mjug gi don no/ /dang po la gnyis/ phyag 'tshal ba dang / mchod par brjod pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rang bzhin dri med blo gros glo bur gyi/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ mkha' 'gro grangs med stong phrag bdun cu gnyis/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ gnyis pa la gnyis/ rgyas par bstod pa dang / bsdus te bstod pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ sa dang lha'i rim pa ltar bstod pa dang / byang chub kyi sems 'pho ba'i rim pa ltar bstod pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ sa bcu gsum pa dang bcu gnyis pa'i sgo nas gtso mo la bstod pa dang / sa dang po nas bcu gcig pa'i bar gyis 'khor la bstod pa dang / gtso 'khor rnams kyi rnam pa'i sgo nas thun mong du bstod pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ sa bcu gsum pa'i sgo nas bstod pa dang / sa bcu gnyis pa'i sgo nas bstod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sbas pa'i rtsa lnga bdud bral cha dang bcas/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ dbus gnas g.yas g.yon rgyab kyi cha la bzhugs/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa 'khor la bstod pa la bcu gcig ste/ sa dang po'i sgo nas rdo rje ma dang gsang ba'i dkar mo la bstod pa ni/ pu lir mi phyed so dang sen mo'i khams/

/zhes sogs tshigs bcad gsum gyis bstan/ sa gnyis pa'i sgo nas chu'i rnal 'byor ma la bstod pa ni/ go ḍa ba rir thung du chu rgyus 'bab/ /ces sogs tshigs bcad gnyis kyis bstan/ sa gsum pa'i sgo nas puk+ka sī la bstod pa ni/ ka ma ru par skyon ma mig 'bab cing / /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ sa bzhi pa'i sgo nas sha wa ri la bstod pa ni/ tri sha ku nor ma mo glo pa 'bab/ /ces sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ sa lnga pa'i sgo nas tsaṇ+ḍa'i li la bstod pa ni/ ka ling kar ni bsil sbyin chu rgyus 'bab/ /ces sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ sa drug pa'i sgo nas g.yung mo la bstod pa ni/ kañtsir gzhol ma snying 'bab kha ba'i rir/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ sa bdun pa'i sgo nas gau ri la bstod pa ni/ pre tar shin tu gzugs can bad kan 'bab/ /ces sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ sa brgyad pa'i sgo nas tsau rī la bstod pa ni/ sau ra trar ni rgyu sbyin khrag 'bab cing / /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ sa dgu pa'i sgo nas bai ta li la bstod pa ni/ na ga rar ni sdug gur tshil bu 'bab/ /ces sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ sa bcu pa'i sgo nas ghasma rī la bstod pa ni/ ma ror mtshed mas mchil ma 'bab pa 'dzin/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ sa bcu gcig pa'i sgo nas sa spyod ma dang mkha' spyod ma la bstod pa ni/ sum skor 'dod ma reg bya sa spyod sbyong / /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis kyis bstan/ gsum pa gtso 'khor rnams kyi rnam pa'i sgo nas bstod pa ni/ kun kyang chos dbyings ngo bos nag mor bzhugs/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis kyis bstan/ spyi don gnyis pa byang chub kyi sems 'pho ba'i rim pa ltar bstod pa la gnyis/ brtsams pa'i rgyu dang / brtsams pa'i don no/ /dang po ni/ de ltar sa dang lha yis rim pa bzhin/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/

gnyis pa ni brtsams pa'i don la gnyis/ bshad par dam bca' ba dang / bstod pa dngos so/ /dang po ni/ skyes dang bud med dbye ba yis/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ bstod pa dngos la gsum/ shes rab lha mo bco lnga la bstod pa dang / thabs he ru ka la bstod pa dang / thabs shes gnyis med la bstod pa'o/ /dang po shes rab lha mo la bstod pa la bco lnga ste/ dang po mkha' spyod ma la bstod pa ni/ tshes gcig lug gi 'pho ba la/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ gnyis pa sa spyod ma la bstod pa ni/ khyu mchog 'pho ba tshes gnyis la/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gi bstan/ gnyis pa ghasmā ri la bstod pa ni/ tshes gsum 'khrig pa'i nyi ma la/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ bzhi pa bai ta li la bstod pa ni/ bzhi pa karka ṭa yi tshes/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ lnga pa tsā+au ri la bstod pa ni/ lnga pa seng ge'i 'pho ba ste/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ drug pa gau rī la bstod pa ni/ bu mo'i 'pho ba tshes drug la/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ bdun pa g.yung mo la bstod pa ni/ tshes bdun srang gi 'pho ba ste/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ brgyad pa tsaṇ+ḍa li la bstod pa ni/ sdig pa'i 'pho ba tshes brgyad la/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ dgu pa sha wa ri la bstod pa ni/ gzhu yi 'pho ba tshes dgu ste/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ bcu pa puk+ka sī la bstod pa ni/ tshes bcu chu srin 'pho ba la/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ bcu gcig pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la bstod pa ni/ bum pa'i 'pho ba bcu gcig la/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ bcu gnyis pa chu'i rnal 'byor ma la bstod pa ni/ bcu gnyis nya yi 'pho ba ste/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ bcu gsum pa gsang ba'i dkar mo la bstod pa ni/

zla ba gzas zin bcu gsum pa/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ bcu bzhi pa rdo rje ma la bstod pa ni/ nyi ma gzas zin bcu bzhi pa/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ bco lnga pa rdo rje bdag med ma la bstod pa ni/ thig le 'gog pa bco lnga yi/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa thabs he ru ka la bstod pa ni/ spyi gtsug āḥste kun 'dar ma/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ gsum pa thabs shes gnyis med la bstod pa la bzhi ste/ mdor bstan pa/ rgyas par bshad pa/ rtsod pa spangs pa/ grub don bsdus te bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'pho ba gnyis dang rtsa bzhi dang / /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ g.yas g.yon gzung 'dzin rtsa ste kun 'dar mas/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ gal te sbyang gzhi lhag ma gnas she na/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ bzhi pa ni/ des na rdo rje theg pa'i zab don kun/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ de yan chad kyis rgyas par bstod pa bshad zin nas/ da ni gzhung don gnyis pa bsdus te bstod pa la gnyis/ bstod pa'i rgyu bstan pa dang bstod pa dngos so/ /dang po ni/ rgyas par rab tu bstod pa ni/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ /phung po khams dang skye mched sbyong ba smin byed dang bcas bskyed pa'i phyogs la lha mo bco lnga'i dngos/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ gsum pa mjug gi don la/ brtsams pa'i dge ba bsngo ba dang / brtsams pa'i tshul bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ rang tshim par bsngo ba dang / gzhan thar par bsngo ba gnyis kyi dang po ni/ bstod pas mgrin pa brgyan par ni/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug la/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ da ni brtsams pa'i tshul bstan pa la/ bstod pa'i ming rtsom pa po'i gang zag

brtsams pa'i gnas/ nyes pa bshags shing slar yang dge ba bsngo ba rnams ni/ lha mo bco lnga'i bstod pa'i gzhung / /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ gsum pa 'jug gi don ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang bcas pa'i lha mo bco lnga la bstod pa/ /zhes pa nas/ lam gyi bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ 'dir smras pa/ nyung gsal tshig gi zab don rgya mtsho rnams/ /legs par rtogs byed don 'grel khog phub 'di/ /sa skya'i rje btsun dgongs don ji bzhin du/ /bkod pa 'di la dpyod ldan kun dges mdzod/ /'di brtsams dge bas bdag dang rjes 'jug rnams/ /lto chos lag len phra mos ma khengs par/ /rgyud don rtogs pa'i rta bdun snang ba yis/ /rang bzhin dri med rang zhal mthong bar shog /rgyud sde'i nges gsang 'dus pa'i gsung rab 'di/ /sngon gyi sa skya'i bstan 'dzin thams cad kyis/ /gces par bzung mod deng dus rjes 'jug rnams/ /bstan bcos 'di yi ming tsam shes pa'ang nyung / /de phyir gong ma'i gsung rab dri med rnams/ /rtag snyoms bzhugs pa bdag gis ma bzod nas/ /blo gsal rnams kyis thos bsam bkur bsti sogs/ /'byung phyir bsdus don legs bshad 'di bris so/ /bsod nams 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba yis/ /sa skya'i rje btsun thugs dgongs rab rdzogs nas/ /bdag dang gdul byar bcas pa'i 'di phyi'i don/ /kun kyang 'bad med yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig /ces rgyud gsum la 'jug pa rin po che'i 'phreng ba dri ma med pa zhes bya ba'i don 'grel khog phub 'phrin las mkha' khyab ces bya ba 'di ni/ grub pa'i 'khor lo bsgyur ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang po dang / rgyal sras sbas pa'i rnal 'byor sems dpa' chen po sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po rgyal ba mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/

sprul pa'i sku spyan snga rin po che kun dga'i mtshan can rnams kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab rnams la zhib tu dpyad de/ chu mo phag gi lo smin drug zla ba'i dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes la/ dpal sa skya'i lha chen rig 'dzin pho brang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni shabs stod pa bkra shis don 'grub kyis bgyis so/ 'di la nyes pa'i tshogs mchis na bla ma dang mkha' 'gros bzod par mdzad nas/ /'di'i 'phrin las nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i bstod pa rgyud gsum la 'jug pa rin po che'i phreng ba'i don 'grel khog phub/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
